bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Quarterback Caleb Williams practiced in full for a second straight day on Thursday as he recovers from a hamstring injury, but his status for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons remains uncertain, with Williams himself saying "I do not know if I'm playing yet". lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are using their bye week to address roster needs, signing a veteran wide receiver after expecting to lose returner Tom Kennedy to a season-ending injury, while also getting positive news as center Cade Mays returns to the lineup. Running back Jahmyr Gibbs added to his strong season by earning NFC Offensive Player of the Week honors for the fourth time, as the team looks to build momentum heading into the second half of the 2026 season.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: Running back Josh Jacobs filed a lawsuit to have evidence in his battery case permanently sealed , a legal move that surfaced October 15 as the Packers prepare for their primetime matchup. On the field, the team is riding momentum into their Week 6 Sunday Night Football showdown against the Cowboys, with safety Xavier McKinney appearing on national TV to discuss Green Bay's strong performance in last week's win over the Bears.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings enter their Week 6 bye at a perfect 5-0 after a 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints, with safety Byron Murphy Jr. earning NFC Defensive Player of the Week honors and the team vaulting into the top five of the latest NFL power rankings.
